pictures.name: sunrise_over_the_courts
pictures.scene: a wide paved court taking the first level light of sunrise, the nearest flagstones lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the far colonnade and the sky above it pale and soft and wide open

pictures.name: pillared_court_at_morning
pictures.scene: a row of heavy stone pillars standing along one side of a swept court, their bases lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the shafts above them rising quiet and grey into a bright and empty sky

pictures.name: flowering_almond_branch
pictures.scene: one almond branch in full white flower held low across the frame, the nearest blossom lit warm and bright, the branches beyond it thinning away into a soft green shade with nothing behind them

pictures.name: treasured_stone
pictures.scene: a single deep red carnelian resting in the hollow of a worn grey rock, the stone glowing warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the rough surface around and above it dim and plain and quiet

pictures.name: great_mountain_above_cloud
pictures.scene: an immense mountain standing far above a level floor of white cloud, the near ridge lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the great pale summit and the sky around it cool and vast

pictures.name: wide_sky_over_open_land
pictures.scene: a great open plain lying flat under an enormous sky, the near grass lit warm and low along the bottom of the frame, the sky above it holding a slow and unbroken depth of blue from one edge to the other

pictures.name: clouds_lifting_off_the_sea
pictures.scene: tall columns of cloud rising off a wide calm sea at the far end of the day, the near water lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the towering cloud above it dim and grey and very still

pictures.name: wind_across_the_dunes
pictures.scene: long sand dunes with fine streamers of blown sand lifting from their crests, the nearest slope lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the ridges beyond them going pale and flat into a low haze

pictures.name: dark_over_the_river_delta
pictures.scene: a broad slow river spreading through flat reed country under a heavy darkening sky, the near water and reeds lit warm and low, the great cloud above them closing over the whole width of the frame

pictures.name: fallen_column_in_the_sand
pictures.scene: one broken stone column lying half buried in drifted sand, its nearest drum lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the empty desert beyond it running out flat to a colourless and distant horizon

pictures.name: empty_hill_fort
pictures.scene: the low ruined walls of a hill fort standing open to the sky on a bare summit, the nearest stones lit warm and long by a late sun, the enclosure inside them empty and quiet and grown over with grass

pictures.name: divided_fields_from_the_ridge
pictures.scene: a wide country of small fields divided by low stone walls seen from a ridge, the nearest walls and grass lit warm and gold, the far fields above them softening into a pale and even evening light

pictures.name: ancient_cedar_still_standing
pictures.scene: one enormous old cedar standing alone on a rocky shoulder, its vast trunk lit warm and hard along the bottom of the frame, the broad flat branches above it dark and heavy against a wide pale sky

pictures.name: water_brought_to_dry_ground
pictures.scene: a narrow channel of clear water running out across cracked dry earth with green shoots already showing along its edge, the water lit bright and warm low in the frame, the plain beyond it flat and dim

pictures.name: poured_metal_left_to_cool
pictures.scene: a rough lump of poured silver and gold left to cool on a bed of sand, its dull surface catching one warm low light at the bottom of the frame, the workshop floor around it brown and empty and still

pictures.name: stone_block_unworked
pictures.scene: a single squared block of pale stone standing on a dusty floor with no mark upon it at all, its nearest side lit warm and hard, the wall behind it and the space above it dim and plain and silent

pictures.name: abandoned_workshop_bench
pictures.scene: a heavy wooden bench with cold tools lying scattered on it and thick dust over everything, the near end of the bench lit warm and low, the room beyond it dark and shut up and long out of use

pictures.name: three_lamps_on_a_ledge
pictures.scene: three small clay lamps burning together on one long stone ledge, their flames and the ledge beneath them lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the wall above them rising dark and quite bare

pictures.name: city_at_golden_evening
pictures.scene: a walled hill city taking the last gold of the evening sun, its lower terraces and gates lit warm and clear, the walls and the sky above them going soft and deep and quiet toward the coming night

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Praise the name of the LORD.
Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
who stand in the house of the LORD,
in the courts of the house of our God.
Hallelujah, for the LORD is good;
sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own,
Israel as His treasured possession.
For I know that the LORD is great;
our Lord is above all gods.
The LORD does all that pleases Him
in the heavens and on the earth,
in the seas and in all their depths.
He causes the clouds to rise
from the ends of the earth.
He generates the lightning with the rain
and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
of both man and beast.
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt,
against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck down many nations
and slaughtered mighty kings:
Sihon king of the Amorites,
Og king of Bashan,
and all the kings of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance,
as a heritage to His people Israel.
Your name, O LORD, endures forever,
Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
For the LORD will vindicate His people
and will have compassion on His servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
made by the hands of men.
They have mouths, but cannot speak;
they have eyes, but cannot see;
they have ears, but cannot hear;
nor is there breath in their mouths.
Those who make them become like them,
as do all who trust in them.
O house of Israel, bless the LORD;
O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
O house of Levi, bless the LORD;
you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Blessed be the LORD from Zion—
He who dwells in Jerusalem.
Hallelujah!
